name: Lightning Swift
effect: Deals additional Energy DMG to enemies attacked within 2 seconds of using Vanishing Step.
note: Activation: After using Vanishing Step. Can activate once every 6 seconds.

name: Super Snowball
effect: Boosts the power of all attacks whenever you score a KO or assist on an enemy hero.
note: Activation: Enemy hero KO or assist. Grants 25 All Attack Up per stack, up to 8 stacks. All stacks are lost when you are KO'd.

name: Build Up
effect: Boosts all defenses whenever you score enough KOs or assists on enemy NPCs.
note: Activation: Every 5 enemy NPC KOs or assists. Grants 22 All Defense Up per stack, up to 10 stacks.

name: Too Easy!
effect: Grants extra HP for 2 seconds when damage brings your HP to 50% or lower.
note: Activation: Take damage that brings current HP to 50% or less. Can activate once every 30 seconds.

name: Strategic Escape
effect: Boosts movement speed while your back is turned to a nearby enemy hero.
note: Activation: Face away from a nearby enemy hero. The effect remains active while the condition is met.

name: GEKISHIN High
effect: Shortens the cooldown of the skill used to activate a GEKISHIN Burst.
note: Activation: Successfully land a GEKISHIN Burst.

name: Giant Slayer
effect: Boosts damage dealt to an enemy hero in proportion to their maximum HP.
note: Activation: Hit an enemy hero while they have 80% or more HP. The effect applies to that target until the confrontation ends.

name: Prepare to Die!
effect: Boosts damage dealt to a weakened enemy hero; the boost becomes much stronger if they survive for at least 2 seconds.
note: Activation: Hit an enemy hero while they have 50% or less HP. The effect ends when the confrontation ends.

name: Steel Skin
effect: Reduces a fixed amount of damage from every hit received from an enemy hero.
note: Activation: Take an attack from an enemy hero. The reduction is applied per hit.

name: Solid Barrier
effect: Grants a barrier that greatly reduces damage from enemy heroes after avoiding hero damage for 15 seconds.
note: Activation: Take no damage from enemy heroes for 15 seconds. The barrier breaks 1.5 seconds after it is damaged by an enemy hero.

name: Art of Decoy
effect: Greatly boosts movement speed and increases Vanishing Step cooldown recovery speed for 6 seconds.
note: Activation: Become obstructed by an enemy hero. Can activate once every 10 seconds.

name: Epic Hunter
effect: Boosts damage dealt to a boss for 4 seconds.
note: Activation: Damage a boss while it has 50% or less HP. The effect ends when the last boss meeting the condition is KO'd.

name: Wicked Warrior
effect: Boosts Rush Attack damage after repeatedly striking the same enemy hero with Rush Attacks.
note: Activation: Land 3 Rush Attacks in a row on one enemy hero. The effect ends 4 seconds after the Rush Attack sequence ends.

name: Pursuer
effect: Deals additional Energy DMG and boosts movement speed while heading toward the affected enemy hero.
note: Activation: Hit one enemy hero with 2 skills within 2 seconds. The movement effect lasts 7.5 seconds and can activate once every 7.5 seconds.

name: Guardian Angel
effect: Takes part of the damage that a nearby ally would receive from an enemy hero.
note: Activation: A nearby ally without Guardian Angel takes damage from an enemy hero. Damage transferred to you is reduced, with additional reduction when more allies are nearby.

name: Defense Step
effect: Reduces damage from enemy heroes for 4 seconds after using Vanishing Step. The effect is much stronger against Super Attacks and decreases over time.
note: Activation: After using Vanishing Step. Internal cooldown: 12 seconds.

name: Backstab
effect: Greatly shortens the cooldown of a skill that hits an enemy hero shortly after you are discovered.
note: Activation: Land a skill other than a Super Attack on an enemy hero within 3 seconds of being discovered.

name: Limit-Breaking Jump
effect: Lets you use Vanishing Step one additional time while its normal cooldown is still active.
note: Activation: Vanishing Step is on cooldown. Can activate once every 6 seconds.
